messages:
pagerbot: INCIDENT: P1 - elevated 503 rate on /v1/generate (us-west1). page: @oncall - see incident runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/api-503

Ava N: I'm on the bridge for this shift, picking up from @Devon K. Paging history shows spike started ~5m ago. Quick check: any deploys?

Devon K: no deploys from my side in the last hour. Saw the alert come in while handing off. I left current investigation notes in the incident doc: `docs/2281234000-investigations` (internal).

Riley Chen: noting customer impact: several 502/503s for hosted API; some clients in us-west1 seeing increased latency and token failures. Logging spike at 2026-03-14T21:20Z.

Ava N: OK we'll do a formal handoff:
- Driver: Riley Chen (active investigation, running mitigations)
- Comms: Ava N (owner for customer/status updates)
- Secondary: Devon K (fallback for config/infra)

Sophia Patel: ack. Can we confirm whether this is router-level or model-serving? I see 503s in the gateway logs but backends show some 200s too.

Riley Chen: running `kubectl -n inference logs -l app=gateway --since=10m` now. Preliminary looks like an upstream timeout from the transformer-pool in us-west1. Pasting key snippets: ```
E0314 21:19:34.123 gateway.go:234] upstream timeout to transformer-pool-3 - dial tcp 10.40.5.7:8080: i/o timeout
E0314 21:19:34.456 gateway.go:237] returning 503 to client
```

Devon K: checking node-level metrics. GPU hosts in us-west1 have high RPS and one node shows OOM killer events 21:17-21:19. Might be capacity exhaustion on a subset.

Ava N: runbook step 1/3: enable canary fallback to a lower-memory model variant in us-west1 (see runbook: `Fallback -> lower-quant model`). Riley, can you trigger the fallback? I'll post a status update to #status and ping support.

Riley Chen: executing fallback command now:```bash
redwoodctl deploy-variant --region us-west1 --service transformer-pool --variant small-quant --drain 30
```

ops-bot: deploy request received: `deploy-variant small-quant` queued. ETA ~45s.

Devon K: while that's rolling, recommendation to increase circuit-breaker timeout between gateway and pool from 3s -> 6s as an immediate mitigation. Graceful for a short window. Will open a quick PR.

Ava N: I'll craft the customer status: "Investigating increased 503s in us-west1 for hosted API. Mitigations underway: rolling fallback to lower-memory variant and temporary timeout increase. No code deploys caused this. Engineers are on it." Posting to status page now.

Ava N: @support @customer-ops posted. (status link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2281234000) :white_check_mark:

Riley Chen: fallback completed. Verification: 5m post-fallback, error rate down ~80% and latency stabilizing. Still monitoring for edge nodes.

Devon K: PR for timeout bump created: https://git.redwood/infra/PR/523 - I'll roll it after review if we need longer-term stability.

Ava N: handoff note to incoming shift at 21:35Z: Riley driving for next 30m to verify stability, Devon on standby for infra escalations. I'll remain comms owner until handoff completes. If error rate stays low for 30m, we de-escalate to P2 and close the P1 war room.

Riley Chen: leaving these commands in the thread for next oncall: `redwoodctl logs --service transformer-pool --region us-west1 --since 30m` and `redwoodctl metrics get --series gateway.errors.us-west1`

Sophia Patel: noted. One action item: follow up on the OOM node - might need instance type adjust or pre-emptive scaling in peak windows.

Ava N: callout: Customer X saw ~12 failed requests, support already offered retry guidance. I'll coordinate a post-incident writeup after close.

pagerbot: REMINDER: Next shift takeover scheduled in 25 minutes. Use `/handoff` to transfer ownership.

Ava N: thanks all. @Riley you'll be primary until I mark handoff complete. @Devon keep an eye on nodes. I'll update the doc with timeline and links. :thumbsup:

Riley Chen: ack. continuing observation, will escalate if regression >10% error rate.

Ava N: last note before handoff: if errors spike again, revert fallback with `redwoodctl rollback-variant --region us-west1 --service transformer-pool --to stable` and escalate to infra oncall.

Riley Chen: got it. closing bridge at 21:41Z unless anything else pops up.
